cats.name: 招财猫 (Zhao Cai Mao)
cats.catName: Zhao Cai Mao (招财猫), the golden beckoning lucky cat (maneki-neko)
cats.whoIsTheCat: Not one real cat: 招财猫 (zhāocáimāo, 'wealth-beckoning cat') is the Chinese name for Japan's maneki-neko, the lucky-cat figure with a raised paw found in shops across Asia. Folklore places its birth in Edo-period Tokyo (Gōtoku-ji, Imado Shrine); records go back to 1852. Gold means wealth, and a raised right paw beckons money. The coin's mascot is a gold cartoon version.

virality.summary: A folk icon rather than one viral post. The maneki-neko has beckoned customers from shop counters since at least the 1850s, and Wikipedia notes it is so popular in Chinese communities that it is often taken for Chinese and called 招财猫. The coin was created on Flap (BNB Chain) on 7 Sep 2026, the same day Flap opened launches against any quote token during BNB Chain's 'coin-stock meme' wave, when new memes began trading against tokenized real-world assets. 招财猫 picked Tether Gold (XAUt): a gold cat paired with gold. Its X banner shows the golden cat meditating on a mountaintop above the clouds.

cats.lore: Zhao Cai Mao is the golden lucky cat that sits by the till in shops and restaurants all over Asia, one paw raised to call good fortune in through the door. Japan knows it as maneki-neko: an old Edo tale says a temple cat once beckoned a lord inside just before a storm broke, and the temple prospered ever after. In Chinese it is 招财猫, the cat who beckons wealth. This one is solid gold, with a red collar, a little bell and a gold coin held to its chest, and it keeps its eyes closed in a contented smile.

cats.name: GTA6CAT (Gato)
cats.catName: Gato, the bodega cat on the ATM in Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2
cats.whoIsTheCat: A fictional, computer-animated brown tabby in Rockstar Games' Grand Theft Auto VI Trailer 2 (6 May 2025): it sits on top of a bodega's ATM, grooming itself as Jason buys beer (spotted by PC Gamer). It has no name in the game; 'Gato' (Spanish for cat) and its backstory come from the coin's fans. Not a real pet; the character is Rockstar's IP.

virality.summary: The cat is a few seconds of background in a record trailer launch: Rockstar said GTA VI Trailer 2 drew 475 million views across platforms in its first 24 hours. PC Gamer's round-up of the trailer's animals (8 May 2025) singled out the bodega cat on the ATM. In August 2026, amid GTA VI gameplay leaks and two days before Rockstar's first official gameplay reveal (27 Aug), fans launched $GATO on pump.fun (25 Aug). X's trending card 'GTA VI Cats Turn Skeptics into Eager Fans' (28 Aug) recapped the cat posts of those days, noting trailers that show cats grooming on ATMs. The coin's site parodies Rockstar's as 'Grand Theft Gato VI', the story of a cat who owns the store.

X trending card of 2026-08-28: a quote-post of 'You can have a pet cat in GTA 6' showed 16K likes and 913K views (about GTA cats in general, not this coin). @TheGTA6cat: 776 followers, 184 posts (joined 2026-08-23). cats.lore: Gato is the bodega cat of Vice City. In the second Grand Theft Auto VI trailer he sits on top of a corner-store ATM and calmly washes himself while Jason buys beer, a few quiet seconds in a trailer full of chaos. Fans noticed, and the cat on the ATM became a small legend. His fan site tells the rest: nobody knows where he came from, the clerk thinks he runs the store, and Gato has never once moved for anyone. One cat, nine lives, zero concerns, and the best seat in the shop.

cats.name: Nya
cats.catName: Nya, the white 'nya~' cat mascot (the new face of the Catgirl community)
cats.whoIsTheCat: A cartoon mascot, not a real cat: a round white cat face with pink ears and a contented ':3' smile, peeking over a golden-yellow circle. 'Nya' is how a cat says meow in Japanese (にゃ). It is the new face of the Catgirl (CATGIRL) community, which launched on BNB Chain in May 2021 and in Sept 2024 rebranded as Nya and spread to seven chains.

virality.summary: Nya grew out of a long-running community rather than one viral clip. Catgirl launched on BNB Chain on 31 May 2021 with anime catgirl NFTs, mystery boxes and the UniPaws world. On 23 Jul 2024 the team announced 'Catgirl Evolution': a new contract, a new brand identity, a DAO and seven chains. On 1 Sep 2024 holders were snapshotted and airdropped the new NYA (1,000 CATGIRL = 1 NYA) on BNB Chain, Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Avalanche, bridged through Axelar. Its motto is 'Say Nya, Spread Love, and Connect'; the site calls nya 'the playful cat sound that's become a symbol of joy and connection', and its banner shows a small cat flying a pink UFO.

cats.lore: Nya is what a cat says in Japanese, and it is also the name of a small white cat with pink ears who smiles with its eyes shut, as if someone just scratched it behind the ear. It grew out of the Catgirl community, a band of anime-loving cat fans who first gathered on BNB Chain in 2021. In 2024 they gave their coin a new face and a new name, spread out across seven chains, and kept one simple motto: say nya, spread love, and connect. On its banners Nya drifts by in a little pink UFO, looking for friends.

It is the 'cats of stocks' idea as a whole collection.

The collection says it is made with love for the terminally onchain, and it keeps a Hall of Fame for its honorary cats.
